about: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1 charts written for MyVocab. The places and figures are invented practice data, not real statistics.
instructions: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

prompts.prompt: The line graph below shows the number of visitors to three museums in the city of Riverton between 2010 and 2022.

chart.title: Visitors to three museums in Riverton

prompts.prompt: The bar chart below shows the average number of hours per week that people in four age groups spent on three leisure activities.

chart.title: Hours per week spent on leisure activities, by age group

prompts.prompt: The pie charts below show how the average household in the country of Northland spent its money in 1995 and 2025.
The table below shows the number of students enrolled in five language courses at Westbridge College in 2018 and 2023.

chart.title: Students enrolled in language courses at Westbridge College

prompts.prompt: The line graph below shows the percentage of households with internet access in three towns between 2004 and 2024.
The bar chart below shows the number of hot coffees, iced coffees and teas sold by a café chain in each season of one year.

chart.title: Drinks sold by a café chain, by season

prompts.prompt: The pie chart below shows how students at Eastfield University usually travel to the campus.

chart.title: How students travel to Eastfield University

prompts.prompt: The table below shows the average monthly rainfall and temperature in the coastal city of Port Calder in six months of the year.

chart.title: Average rainfall and temperature in Port Calder

prompts.prompt: The line graph below shows the amount of electricity produced from coal, wind and solar power in the country of Southland between 2000 and 2020.

chart.title: Electricity produced in Southland, by source

prompts.prompt: The bar chart below shows the percentage of men and women working in five occupations in the country of Eastland.

chart.title: Men and women in five occupations in Eastland

prompts.prompt: The pie charts below show the main reasons why people visited Highmoor National Park in 2005 and 2025.

chart.title: Main reason for visiting Highmoor National Park

prompts.prompt: The table below shows the percentage of household waste that was recycled in four cities in 2010, 2015 and 2020.

chart.title: Household waste recycled in four cities

prompts.prompt: The line graph below shows the price of one cinema ticket and the monthly price of a film streaming service in one country between 2012 and 2024.

chart.title: Price of a cinema ticket and a streaming subscription

prompts.prompt: The bar chart below shows the number of books borrowed from Lakeside Public Library in 2019 and 2024, by type of book.

chart.title: Books borrowed from Lakeside Public Library, by type

prompts.prompt: The pie chart below shows how water is used in a typical home in the country of Westland.

chart.title: Water use in a typical home in Westland
